styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Museums, the Reichstag and the old centre.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: The Wall, Cold War sites and memorials.

styles.label: Nightlife
styles.blurb: Late clubs, bars and street food after dark.

stays.why: Walk to Museum Island, the Reichstag and Unter den Linden. Best first-time base; central transport.
Cheaper, lively and full of food. Close to the East Side Gallery and nightlife; grittier streets.
Quiet, leafy and family-friendly. Cafés and parks; a short tram or U-Bahn ride to the centre.
Classic west Berlin near the palace, Kurfürstendamm shopping and the zoo. Calmer evenings.

food: Try Berlin classics: currywurst, döner kebab and a hearty lunch at a traditional Kneipe.
Street food markets are a cheap, fun dinner. Check days and locations online before you go.
Book popular restaurants ahead, especially at weekends. Many kitchens close by about 22:00.
Vegetarian and vegan options are widespread and good value.
Tap water is safe to drink. A sit-down lunch is often cheaper than dinner.
more_time: Swap a museum afternoon for Potsdam: take the S-Bahn out and walk the parks and palaces.
Add a Spree river cruise for a different view of the centre.
Spend a half day at a former airport park or a lake beach in summer; check transport on the day.

recommend.why: Three nights covers the Wall, Museum Island and a proper night out without rushing.

month_notes: Coldest month: highs around 4°C, lows near -1°C. Pack a warm coat; expect about 14 rain days.
Still cold: highs near 6°C, lows around 0°C. Fewer rain days, about 11.
Warming slowly: highs around 9°C, lows near 1°C. Keep layers; about 12 rain days.
Spring arrives: highs near 14°C, lows around 4°C. Good walking weather; about 9 rain days.
Pleasant: highs around 19°C, lows near 9°C. One of the drier months, about 8 rain days.
Warm: highs near 24°C, lows around 14°C. About 10 rain days; pack a light rain layer.
Warmest: highs around 25°C, lows near 15°C. About 11 rain days.
Warm: highs near 25°C, lows around 16°C. About 9 rain days; good for parks and lakes.
Mild and dry-ish: highs around 21°C, lows near 12°C. About 8 rain days.
Cooler: highs near 15°C, lows around 8°C. About 11 rain days; bring a jacket.
Cold and grey: highs around 8°C, lows near 3°C. About 10 rain days.
Cold: highs near 6°C, lows around 1°C. About 12 rain days; Christmas markets in season.

climate_guide.summary: Temperate climate with cold winters and mild summers. Rain is spread through the year, so pack layers.

items.title: Best time: May to September
items.text: Highs around 19–25°C and lows of 9–16°C. Best for walking, parks and outdoor sights.

items.title: Winter is cold (December to February)
items.text: Highs of 4–6°C and lows near or below freezing. Bring a warm coat, hat and gloves.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: About 8–14 rain days a month. No dry season; carry a small umbrella or rain jacket.

items.title: Wettest months
items.text: January and December have the most rain days, around 12–14. Plan indoor backups.

items.title: Spring and autumn are mild
items.text: April and October sit around 14–15°C highs. Good for sightseeing with fewer crowds.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers, a waterproof jacket and comfortable shoes. Add a warm coat and gloves for November to March.

transit.best: U-Bahn and S-Bahn for most trips; buy a ticket before boarding.

modes.text: U-Bahn and S-Bahn cover most of the city. Buy tickets from machines before boarding.
Buses and trams fill the gaps. Night buses run when trains stop.
Taxis are metered. Uber and Bolt operate, but local apps like Free Now are common.
Driving is stressful: heavy traffic, a low-emission zone and limited parking.
Walking and cycling are great. Watch for bike lanes.
No ferries in the city centre, but river cruises run on the Spree.
